user.title: Connect the crossing advisory service
user.description: Crossing state and predictions are inferred from protecting-signal aspects, not physical barrier telemetry. Always obey physical crossing lights and barriers. Advisory only; not for safety-critical control. Enter the service base URL, without /api/status.

data_description.stale_timeout: Default 90 seconds; polling is every 30 seconds.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the status API. Check the URL, network, and service.
error.invalid_status: The API status is invalid, or its feed is disconnected or stale. Check the service and its clock.

abort.already_configured: This crossing service is already configured.

init.title: Crossing feed freshness
init.description: A disconnected or stale protecting-signal feed makes all advisory sensors unavailable. This does not measure physical barriers.
